artboards.title: Comparison band — standalone view (now embedded in the page)

annotations.text:
Version 0.1.0, "macOS 14 or later" and the MIT licence are real project values.

Still open: no .dmg in GitHub Releases yet, and distribution outside the App Store needs an Apple Developer Program membership ($99/year) for Developer ID signing and notarisation.

Palette and icon are lifted from Spender.icns. The purple in the app screenshots is the user's macOS accent colour, not a brand colour.
